name: Udderly Delighted Creamery
description: Udderly Delighted Creamery is a third-generation family-run dairy nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont. Passionate about pasture-raised cows and the art of artisan cheesemaking, the farm specializes in small-batch milks, butters, yogurts, and an impressive array of cheeses. Their philosophy is rooted in animal welfare, minimal processing, and bold flavor experimentation, delivering both classic staples and whimsical limited-edition dairy treats. All products are made using milk from their own free-roaming cows and are crafted with love—often by hand.

With greenhouses, hoop houses, and open fields, they bring a rainbow of fresh, pickled, and dried veggies to local markets, focusing on sustainability, flavor, and fun. name: Happy Hoof Dairy Collective
description: Nestled in the rolling green pastures of Wisconsin, Happy Hoof Dairy Collective is a cooperative of third-generation dairy farmers dedicated to producing rich, flavorful, and sustainable dairy products. Their herds of Holstein and Jersey cows are grass-fed and pasture-raised, and the farm is renowned for its innovative take on classic and specialty cheeses. Happy Hoof prides itself on animal welfare, eco-friendly farming, and community education, offering regular farm tours and cheese-making classes.

name: Sprout & Root Organic Vegetable Farm

Founded by two botanists with a passion for heirloom varieties, the farm specializes in diverse, nutrient-dense vegetables, rare herbs, and creative produce blends. With a focus on regenerative agriculture, biodiversity, and community-supported agriculture (CSA) boxes, Sprout & Root supplies local restaurants and farmers’ markets with some of the freshest, most unique produce in the region.

The farm blends old-school tree care with new-school culinary innovation, turning classic nuts into spreads, snacks, and decadent treats. The founders love puns (as you’ll see in their product names) and are passionate about allergen-safe practices and transparency in labeling.
